summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancing Spark integration, particularly with the upcoming Spark 4.1 framework and improvements to asynchronous reading for small file workloads. Additionally, proposals for adding Basic Authentication to the OpenAPI specification and implementing incremental computation for statistics maintenance are being actively explored.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Basic Authentication support for REST Catalog OpenAPI
Discussion on adding 404 response for /v1/config endpoint
